title: The Incarnation
intro: The Incarnation is the belief that God the Son became truly human in Jesus, fully God and fully man. It means God entered our world, shares our joys and sufferings, and made it possible for us to share his life. Christmas celebrates this mystery.

title: The Catholic Church
intro: Jesus founded one Church on the apostles, with Peter as its rock, to carry on his mission until he returns. Catholics believe this Church is one, holy, catholic, and apostolic. It is a family of sinners being made holy, not a club of the perfect.
phrasings: why do we need the Church

title: Scripture and Tradition
intro: Catholics believe God's Word comes through both Sacred Scripture and Sacred Tradition, the teaching handed down from the apostles and guarded by the Church. The Bible itself says that not everything Jesus did is written down. The two work together, not against each other.

title: Judgment
intro: Scripture teaches that each of us will stand before God, and that the standard is love, as Jesus describes in the parable of the sheep and goats. The Church speaks of a particular judgment at death and a final judgment at the end of time. We trust in God's mercy while taking our choices seriously.

title: The Resurrection
intro: The Resurrection is the heart of the Christian faith: Jesus really rose from the dead, and in him we are promised new life. Paul says that if Christ is not raised, our faith is in vain. Because he lives, death is not the end.

title: The Second Coming
intro: Christians believe Jesus will return in glory to judge the living and the dead and bring his kingdom to completion. We do not know when, so we are called to live ready. It is a message of hope, not fear.
